data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate opened 2020 with gross claims outstanding of GBP 3,345.9m. During 2020 there was a modest overall prior-year release of gross reserves of GBP 11.5m (a c.0.34% release). Reserve movements were driven by a mix of factors: COVID-19 losses (gross GBP 229.0m; net GBP 136.0m), adverse development on 2019 large losses (causing a net strengthening in the Reinsurance division of GBP 20.0m), and movements from natural catastrophe events in 2020 (e.g. Hurricanes Laura and Sally, Midwest Derecho, various wildfires and tornados). The net picture across divisions was mixed, with Reinsurance showing net strengthening in 2020 while prior-year releases (including on 2018 & prior large losses) supported improvements recognised in 2019.

These events have exceeded our loss expectations for this type of event and contributed 7% to the loss ratio.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves taken from Balance Sheet 'Claims outstanding' prior-year comparative (explicit). Prior-year development (gross) taken from Note 11(a) 'Movements arising from prior year claims' (Insurance liabilities column) which shows (11.5). Some textual reserve commentary in the report quotes net movements (after reinsurance) for divisions (e.g. net reserve releases of GBP 45.0m in 2019 and net strengthening GBP 20.0m in 2020 for Reinsurance); these have been reported verbatim in narrative and used for divisional context but the primary prior_year_development_gbp_m uses the gross figure from the technical provisions note. LOB-level prior-year reserve movements are not provided on a gross basis; the GBP 20.0m and GBP 45.0m amounts quoted in the report are net of reinsurance and have been flagged as such by lower confidence. Claims development triangle is available (gross) and was used for cross-checking.
